title: Convert Tailwind CSS markup and examples into SF5-safe markup
workflow: Confirm the source ownership, license status, and target SF5 surface.
Classify the source markup into utility, component, smart-component, and behavior zones.
Map only known Tailwind patterns to verified SF5 utilities or components.
Generate a conversion report with unmapped classes, assumptions, and manual QA notes.
Validate SF5-ready output with strict class and component checks.
required_outputs: converted SF5 markup or conversion plan
